in_sanskrit.name: Neena
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Pure, Simple
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Neena एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'neeti', meaning guidance or advice. Neena is a name of purity and simplicity, often given to girls who are believed to possess great wisdom and the ability to provide guidance.
